label: ART Renderer
verified: 3ds Max 2027: render settings written and read back; the sun's direction measured from a pole's shadow in two test renders.
notes: ART stops at a noise target in decibels (higher is cleaner), a time limit, or an iteration count, whichever is enabled and reached first.
sun is a Sun Positioner in manual mode with a Physical Sun & Sky environment bound to it, placed by elevation and azimuth. It replaces the scene environment, so an existing one needs replace=True.
The sun is physically bright: without an exposure control (Rendering > Exposure Control > Physical Camera Exposure Control) the frame renders white. Add one, or lower the sun's intensity.
